resources.string: Real time, or one full-resolution frame at a time

Automatic plays RAW takes in real time at half resolution and drops frames to keep time. If this device can\'t keep up, the viewer switches to frame by frame on its own. Frame viewer skips real time and shows one frame at a time at full resolution, which you can step through or scrub. Applies to this device only.
Showing frame by frame: this device can\'t play this RAW take in real time
